name: ActivityIndicator
description: Simple animated indicator that shows background activity.
expectations:
Role: Status / Indicator
Keyboard: Focusable if interactive; Tab/Shift+Tab must move focus out of it without trapping.
Screen reader: Should announce presence and state if relevant (e.g., busy/idle).

name: AnimationCtrl
description: Control that plays short animations (e.g., .ani files).
expectations:
Role: Graphics / Animation
Keyboard: Play/pause controls must be reachable via Tab and exit to next control with Shift+Tab. Do not trap focus.
Screen reader: Provide accessible label and change notifications when play state changes.

name: Button
description: Standard push button. Activatable with Space or Enter; should announce its label and activation state.
expectations:
Role: Button
Keyboard: Space/Enter to activate; Tab/Shift+Tab must move focus away normally.
Screen reader: Announces label and 'pressed' feedback where appropriate.

name: CheckListBox
description: List with a checkbox per item used for multiple selections.
expectations:
Role: List with checkboxes
Keyboard: Arrow keys to move, Space to toggle a checkbox, Tab/Shift+Tab to leave the control (no trapping).
Screen reader: Announces item and checked state.

name: Choice
description: Non-editable dropdown list for selecting a single item.
expectations:
Role: Listbox / ComboBox (collapsed)
Keyboard: Alt+Down to open, Arrow keys to navigate, Enter to select; Tab/Shift+Tab leaves control.
Screen reader: Announces collapsed/expanded and selection.

name: Choicebook
description: A book control where page selection is controlled by a Choice control.
expectations:
Role: Page List / Tab-like
Keyboard: Tab to move to the Choice control, Arrow keys or Alt+Down to select a page; Tab/Shift+Tab must move focus out of the choicebook pages without trapping.
Screen reader: Announces current page and its role.

name: CommandLinkButton
description: A button with a main label and a descriptive sublabel (Windows-style command link).
expectations:
Role: Button
Keyboard: Space/Enter to activate; Tab/Shift+Tab normal traversal.
Screen reader: Announces both main label and descriptive text.

name: ComboBox
description: Editable dropdown where users can type or select existing items.
expectations:
Role: ComboBox
Keyboard: Type to filter, Alt+Down to open; Tab/Shift+Tab leaves control.
Screen reader: Announces value and editable state.

name: EditableListBox
description: Compound control (list plus New/Edit/Delete) that allows editing of list items.
expectations:
Role: Composite control
Keyboard: Tab into the control and between its internal buttons and list; Shift+Tab must exit to previous control and not get trapped.
Screen reader: Announce list items and button purposes; when editing, announce edit dialog state.

name: FileCtrl
description: A file chooser control providing directory and file navigation UI.
expectations:
Role: File chooser / Composite
Keyboard: All interactive parts (tree, list, filename entry, buttons) must be reachable and focusable with Tab and Shift+Tab; ensure no focus trapping when entering nested panes.
Screen reader: Announce current directory, selected file, and control hints.

name: Grid
description: Spreadsheet-like grid for tabular data; cells can be selected and edited.
expectations:
Role: Grid / Table
Keyboard: Arrow keys to move between cells, Enter to edit, Tab/Shift+Tab to move out of the grid (or into next focusable cell depending on editing mode). Test both editing and navigation behavior for trapping.
Screen reader: Announce row/column and cell value.

name: HtmlListBox
description: ListBox capable of rendering HTML fragments per item.
expectations:
Role: List
Keyboard: Arrow keys to move, Tab/Shift+Tab to move focus away.
Screen reader: Ideally announces plain text fallback; if rendering HTML, ensure accessible name and role are exposed.

name: ListBox
description: Single and multi-select lists for selecting items.
expectations:
Role: List
Keyboard: Arrow keys, Shift+arrow for range, Ctrl+Space to toggle in multi-select; Tab/Shift+Tab must leave the list without trapping.
Screen reader: Announces item and position (e.g., '3 of 12').

name: ListCtrl
description: Flexible list control with multiple view modes (report, icon, small icon, list).
expectations:
Role: List/Table (report mode)
Keyboard: Arrow keys to navigate items; in report mode, announce columns; Tab/Shift+Tab must move focus out of the control. Test focus behavior when switching view modes to avoid Replace(NULL) issues.
Screen reader: Announces item, column headers, and position.

name: ListCtrlViews
description: Helper view that switches a ListCtrl between Report/List/Icon/SmallIcon modes for testing.
expectations:
Role: View switcher + List control
Keyboard: Controls to switch modes should be reachable by Tab; ensure focus is preserved after mode changes and not trapped.
Screen reader: Announces current view mode and item info.

name: MediaCtrl
description: Control to play audio/video content.
expectations:
Role: Media Player
Keyboard: Play/pause/seek controls must be keyboard accessible and allow exiting to surrounding controls with Tab/Shift+Tab; no trapping.
Screen reader: Announce playback state, current time, and controls.

name: PropertyGrid
description: Grid of named properties allowing editing of different data types (strings, colors, fonts).
expectations:
Role: Grid / Property editor
Keyboard: Tab/Shift+Tab must move between properties and out of the grid; editing popups (color chooser, font dialog) must return focus to the grid and not trap keyboard.
Screen reader: Announce property name, type, and current value. Be defensive when restoring complex types (fonts/colors).

name: RadioButton
description: Mutually-exclusive option control; often used in groups or RadioBox.
expectations:
Role: Radio button
Keyboard: Arrow keys to move within group, Tab/Shift+Tab to move out of group; ensure focus is not trapped inside a radio group.
Screen reader: Announce group and position (e.g., '2 of 4').

name: RearrangeCtrl
description: AGW control for reordering a list of items with Up/Down and Add/Remove buttons.
expectations:
Role: Composite reordering control
Keyboard: All internal buttons and list must be reachable and leaveable via Tab/Shift+Tab; ensure operations update accessible name/position. If AGW unavailable, a shim must provide equivalent keyboard behavior.

name: RichTextCtrl
description: Rich text editor supporting formatting, hyperlinks, and complex content.
expectations:
Role: Rich edit / Document
Keyboard: Standard editing keys; Tab/Shift+Tab may be used for UI commands—ensure a clear focus path to exit editing mode so Tab doesn't get trapped.
Screen reader: Announce document structure and formatting where possible.

name: SplitterWindow
description: Window split into two panes with a draggable sash, used to host two independent controls.
expectations:
Role: Container with split panes
Keyboard: Sash should be keyboard-manipulable if interactive; Tab/Shift+Tab must move focus into and out of panes predictably without trapping.
Screen reader: Announce pane boundaries and focus changes.

name: Toolbook
description: Book control navigated via a toolbar of tools (icons) to switch pages.
expectations:
Role: Page container
Keyboard: Tool buttons must be reachable by Tab and switch pages via Enter/Space; Tab/Shift+Tab must exit pages and not trap focus.
Screen reader: Announce page titles and selected state.

name: ToolBar
description: Toolbar containing tool buttons and controls for quick actions.
expectations:
Role: Toolbar
Keyboard: Tools must be navigable via Tab and arrow keys where appropriate; no focus trapping; screen readers should announce tooltips and enabled state.

name: Treebook
description: Book control navigated via a TreeCtrl to choose pages.
expectations:
Role: Page container with tree navigation
Keyboard: Tree navigation must allow focus out with Tab/Shift+Tab; ensure selecting a tree node doesn't trap keyboard.
Screen reader: Announce tree node and selected page.

name: TreeCtrl
description: Hierarchical tree control for nested items and expand/collapse functionality.
expectations:
Role: Tree
Keyboard: Left/Right to collapse/expand, Arrow keys to navigate, Tab/Shift+Tab to leave the control. Report any focus trapping as a bug.
Screen reader: Announce hierarchy and expanded/collapsed state.

name: TextCtrl
description: Single-line and multi-line text entry controls for free text input.
expectations:
Role: Edit / Text
Keyboard: Arrow keys, Home/End, Ctrl+A for select all; Tab/Shift+Tab must move focus out when not in multi-line editing mode; in multi-line mode verify whether Tab inserts a tab character or moves focus based on design.
Screen reader: Announce role and current text.

name: WXWebView
description: Embedded web view (wx.html2.WebView) for rendering HTML content and web pages.
expectations:
Role: Embedded web content
Keyboard: Web content may manage its own focus; ensure Tab/Shift+Tab can move the focus into and back out of the web view. If focus becomes trapped inside web content, report as integration bug and provide a programmatic way to exit (e.g., Escape to return focus).
Screen reader: Web content should expose accessible names/roles via the embedded engine (e.g., MSHTML/Chromium); test with screen reader to verify announcements.
